execution.implementation: ProteinGym v1.3 first-500-row extraction and deterministic four-site 80-dimensional one-hot encoding plus a separate Rosalind launcher observation; no Rosalind scientific job executed

observations: The retained ProteinGym subset contains 500 variants with 448-residue full-protein sequences.
The deterministic encoding contains 500 rows and 80 categorical dimensions for positions 265, 266, 267, and 280.
The selected rows contain 2 single, 44 double, and 454 triple mutants; their recorded DMS scores range from 0.0 to 6.2011354501.
interpretation: The one-hot representation preserves the identity of each assayed residue and is suitable for transparent teaching or simple downstream models.
The source DMS scores describe the SPG1_STRSG_Wu_2016 binding assay, while the embedding and summaries are local computations.
limitations: The first 500 archive rows are deterministic but are not a balanced or random sample of the complete landscape.
The categorical encoding omits evolutionary, structural, and protein-language-model context.
No ESM model or sequence viewer was executed.
The Rosalind call verified launcher readiness only and executed no scientific job.
Wall time is hardware and runtime dependent.

provenance.note: The builder records the archive member and selection rule before generating the encoding, summaries, timing record, and data-driven preview. outputs/rosalind-open-observation.json records the genuine mcp__rosalind__rosalind_open call separately and states that no scientific job executed.
